IC1: Healthy subjects: Adults (≥21 years of age) in the [NOT] absence of a history of HFpEF [OR] or HFrEF, pulmonary, [OR] neurologic, [OR] orthopedic, or other diseases affecting the neuromuscular system.

IC5: - Patients with a history stable ([NOT] no medication changes in past 6 weeks (w/duration of diagnosis >6 months).
IC6: - New York Heart Association class I-III.
IC7: - Current [NOT] non-smokers with <15 pack year history.
IC8: - [NOT] Non-pregnant women, [AND] and individuals who are able to exercise (i.e. [NOT] without orthopedic limitations [OR] or neuromuscular disorders).
